values.note: Rate for the shelter campsite at Campbell's Lake; a reservation runs from 11 am to 11 am the next day.

fees.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('Family camping sites with shelters (1A, 1B, 2, 5, 6, 7 and the shelter at Campbell's Lake) $15/day'; Cambell's Lake Site '$15 per night'; 'Reservations run from 11 a.m. on day one until 11 a.m. the following day'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations are required and are made only by calling the Sand Hills State Forest office, (843) 498-6478, during office hours (Mon-Fri 8 am-12 pm and 12:30-4 pm). Campers must camp in the reserved site.

booking.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('Campers must obtain a reservation from the Sand Hills State Forest office during office hours'; 'You must call the Sand Hills office during office hours to make camping reservations in order to camp on the property: (843) 498-6478') + https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/ ('Office hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-12 p.m. / 12:30-4 p.m.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A single campsite with a shelter, picnic table, fireplace and trash can beside the cypress pond, off Campbell's Lake Road and Old Hwy 1 about 4 miles north of Patrick. Generators are allowed.

sites.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('Four additional campsites are available, one with an accompanying shelter at Campbell's Lake'; 'Shelter with no restroom next to Campbell's Lake. Picnic table, fireplace, trash can. On beautiful cypress pond'; 'Off Campbell's Lake Road and Old Hwy 1 Road. 4 miles north of Patrick'; 'Generators ARE allowed at campsites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No restroom at this site; the forest's three restrooms are at Mountain Pond, Sugarloaf Mountain and the equine camping area.

facilities.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('Shelter with no restroom next to Campbell's Lake'; 'There are three restroom facilities: one near Mountain Pond, one at Sugarloaf Mountain and one at the equine camping area'), read 2026-10-21

note: Large waterfront site w/shelter on beautiful cypress lake. --AWH
summary: SC Forestry Commission (Sand Hills State Forest) single shelter campsite: confirmed $15/night (now manual, 2026), reservation required by phone to the forest office during office hours, never first-come; 1 site, no restroom, generators allowed. Drive-in: the forest's aerial photo of the site shows a car parked on the sand clearing beside the shelter, reached by a sand road; the page does not state road surface or a vehicle length. Note trimmed of the price and booking facts. Not stated: season, hookups, site length.
flags: RV access not stated: scfc.gov gives no road description or vehicle limit for the Campbell's Lake site (off Campbell's Lake Road / Old Hwy 1, 4 mi north of Patrick); its aerial photo (https://www.scfc.gov/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/campbells-lake-aerial-scaled.jpg) shows a passenger vehicle parked on an open sand clearing beside the shelter, reached by an unpaved sand track. No 4WD/high-clearance statement either way. Nothing contrary found; recorded so a human knows the 23-ft fit rests on the photo and AWH's note.
